items.html: Hilltop Sustainability Program
Now Hiring:

The City of Columbus and SWACO are partnering in the Hilltop on the Recycle Right program, encouraging families and residents to recycle using the city’s blue residential recycling container for biweekly collection. MY Project USA is currently recruiting volunteer and paid program ambassadors to assist in targeted educational outreach to Hilltop households on how to recycle correctly and how recycling benefits our community.

items.text: MY Project USA is recruiting Volunteer and Paid Ambassadors to raise awareness and educate our Hilltop neighbors about recycling.

items.html: Sustainability Ambassador

Between April 2nd – May 31st on Saturdays from 9:30am - 1:30pm,  Ambassadors will work as a member of a community outreach team that will be educating residents about “Recycling Right” and proper Waste practices. Ambassadors will complete training with the City of Columbus / SWACO on how to “Recycle Right” and proper waste practices (trash, illegal dumping, bulk collection) virtually at their convenience prior to the start date (time spent on training will be paid).
